dialogues.title: В малой группе: уточнить и обосновать
dialogues.prompt: You missed question five. Ask your partner to read the clue aloud and then ask where you can find the answer.
dialogues.answer: Could you read the clue out loud, please? Could you tell me where we can find the answer?

dialogues.title: Договорись, кто за кем заедет
dialogues.prompt: Ask politely whether your partner can pick you up, then find out what time they plan to leave.
dialogues.answer: Would you mind picking me up at my mum’s? Could you tell me what time you’re planning to leave?

dialogues.title: Попроси преподавателя о конкретной обратной связи
dialogues.prompt: Ask the tutor to point out one specific mistake and give you a chance to say it again.
dialogues.answer: Could you point out one thing I could say more naturally? Would it be all right if I tried again?

dialogues.title: Четыре формы будущего
dialogues.prompt: Make plans for a play. Give a timetable, an arrangement, an earlier intention and an offer you make during the conversation.
dialogues.answer: The performance starts at seven. I’m meeting Alex outside the theatre at six. I’m going to book the tickets tonight. Do you need a lift? I’ll pick you up.

dialogues.title: Экодом и полезные технологии
dialogues.prompt: Continue the dialogue with your plans for an eco-house. Say what you’ve already decided, what you’ve arranged for Friday and what you can offer to do now.
dialogues.answer: We’re going to improve the insulation first. A technician is coming to check the smart meter on Friday. I’ll send you the energy readings now.

dialogues.title: Мои занятия и цели в английском
dialogues.prompt: Tell your tutor how you’ll practise next week. Include a prior intention, a booked session and a decision you make while speaking.
dialogues.answer: I’m going to practise writing clearer emails. I’m meeting my conversation partner on Tuesday. Actually, I’ll write a short draft tonight.

dialogues.title: Фильм, мнение и вежливое несогласие
dialogues.prompt: Your partner loved the ending. Acknowledge their opinion, disagree gently and give one specific reason.
dialogues.answer: I see what you mean. The twist was surprising, but it felt rushed to me because the characters barely had time to react.

dialogues.title: Экодом и полезные технологии
dialogues.prompt: Your partner wants to install underfloor heating first. Acknowledge the idea, then argue for another priority and explain why.
dialogues.answer: I can see why you’d choose underfloor heating. I’d start with insulation, though. The house loses a lot of heat through the walls.

dialogues.title: Договорись, кто за кем заедет
dialogues.prompt: Your partner wants to drive at peak time. Acknowledge their point, then politely suggest taking the train or leaving earlier.
dialogues.answer: I see why driving would be easier with Sam. I’m not sure about leaving that late, though. Would it work if we left half an hour earlier?
